patches_removed.name: Hide Video Store on home
patches_removed.description: Removes the "Letterboxd Video Store" promo row from the Films tab. The Video Store itself, its settings and every other entry point are left untouched. Can be toggled from the "Mod settings" screen if that patch is also enabled.

patches_removed.name: Hide ratings until watched
patches_removed.description: Hides the community rating (average + histogram) on a film's page until you have marked that film as watched, covering it with a tap-to-reveal control. The reveal is per visit — leave the film and come back and it is hidden again. Only the film page is affected; ratings shown in lists, search and elsewhere are unchanged.

patches_removed.name: Match bottom nav to top bar color
patches_removed.description: Paints Letterboxd's bottom navigation bar black (#000000), matching the top bar, instead of the default slate. Can be toggled from the "Mod settings" screen if that patch is also enabled; the change applies on the next app start. With "Material You theme" also on, this wins — turn it off to keep the Material You nav tint.

patches_modified.name: Appearance
patches_modified.description: In-app appearance controls, adjustable from the Letterboxd Mods screen without re-patching: a true-black OLED surface, a custom accent colour (presets or any hex), and the bottom-navigation selected style. Applied at runtime via resource overlays on Android 12 and later. Needs the "Mod settings" patch. If the separate "Material You theme" patch is also applied, its OLED and nav-bar-match switches are disabled here automatically — the two theming systems can't run at once.

patches_modified.name: Brighter Watched-by stars
patches_modified.description: Other people's star ratings in a film's "Watched by" row use a very dark grey (#445566) that is hard to read, especially on a black theme. This switches them to the lighter grey (#99AABB) the rest of the app already uses for other people's ratings. A small legibility fix, on by default.

patches_modified.name: Denser poster grid
patches_modified.description: Tightens the spacing around posters in grids so they render larger and closer together. Does not change the number of columns.

patches_modified.name: Material You theme
patches_modified.description: Repaints Letterboxd's dark chrome — window background, surfaces, cards, the top bar, tab strip, bottom nav and sheets — from the device's Material You palette on Android 12+ (no effect below). No accent or OLED options here; those live in the "Mod settings" screen — but that screen's "Pure black (OLED)" and "Match bottom nav" switches turn themselves off while this patch is applied, since it already repaints those surfaces on its own. No effect on Jetpack Compose screens.

patches_modified.name: Mod settings
patches_modified.description: HOW TO OPEN: long-press the settings gear on your profile tab. — This adds a "Letterboxd Mods" screen that collects the other patches' options (theme, accent, hide ratings, hide video store, hide where to watch, open in player, match bottom nav, etc.) so you can change them inside the app instead of re-patching. Some changes apply immediately, others after a restart, and you'll be prompted either way.

patches_modified.name: Block Brave Telemetry
patches_modified.description: Blocks P3A product analytics, Brave Stats usage pings, crash dump uploads, WDP, and Variations seed fetching.

patches_modified.name: Brave In-Product & Commercial Notification Optimizer
patches_modified.description: Eliminates background wakeups and notifications from Chromium tips scheduler (Job ID 105), Brave Rewards onboarding promo, and retention marketing campaigns.

patches_modified.name: Brave Origin
patches_modified.description: Unlocks Brave Origin and enables local feature toggle controls.

patches_modified.name: Brave Startup Performance Optimization
patches_modified.description: Optimizes startup time and eliminates background CPU/disk overhead by disabling unused OEM carrier partner customizations.

patches_modified.name: Disable Background Sync & Periodic Sync
patches_modified.description: Eliminates background wakeups, radio modem activity, and battery drain by forcing GooglePlayServicesChecker.shouldDisableBackgroundSync() -> true and neutralizing wakeup tasks.

patches_modified.name: Disable Battery Status API & OS Listener
patches_modified.description: Neutralizes the Android BatteryStatusManager broadcast listener to prevent continuous OS battery wakeups.

patches_modified.name: Disable Pull To Refresh
patches_modified.description: Completely disables the pull-to-refresh overscroll gesture and animation to prevent accidental page reloads.

patches_modified.name: Locale PAK Slimmer
patches_modified.description: Strips unselected language resource PAKs from assets/locales/.

patches_modified.name: Native Bloat Slimmer
patches_modified.description: Strips unused native companion binaries (Impress Vision AI, WireGuard VPN, and Android XR) to significantly reduce APK size.

patches_modified.name: PNG Asset Optimizer
patches_modified.description: Losslessly recompresses PNG assets with maximum zlib compression and strips non-rendering metadata chunks (pHYs, tEXt, tIME) while preserving 9-patch structures and pixel accuracy.

patches_modified.name: Skip First Run
patches_modified.description: Skips the welcome screen, search engine selection, and onboarding First Run Experience (FRE) on clean installs.
